Game Overview

The Entity 2 puts players into a horror experience centered on quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Each session of The Entity 2 follows a consistent rhythm. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is The Entity 2?

The Entity 2 is a free horror game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is The Entity 2 free to play?

Yes, The Entity 2 is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
